obfuscation_indicators: forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantified and provides useful year-over-year drivers, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and qualitative explanations for several expense changes. Key risks include ongoing average selling price erosion, semiconductor cyclicality, product-development complexity, tax uncertainty, and customer/market concentration, although operating performance is presented in a broadly favorable tone.
